DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Leukemia (likely Acute Promyelocytic Leukemia given the description of needle-shaped cytoplasmic inclusions).

The combination of severe pancytopenia (low hemoglobin and platelets) with a dramatic leukocytosis (81,000 WBC) and the specific finding of immature cells with needle-shaped cytoplasmic inclusions (Auer rods) on the smear is diagnostic for Acute Promyelocytic Leukemia.
